parts.text:
‘Smartphones have done more harm than good to young people's friendships.’

Write an article for a national newspaper in which you give your views on this statement.

Your article may include:
• the ways phones help or harm friendships
• how young people could use technology more wisely
• any other points you wish to make.

Your answer will be assessed on how accurately and appropriately you use vocabulary, spelling, punctuation and grammar.

parts.text:
Answer ONE of the following tasks, (a) or (b).

**EITHER**

**(a)** ‘School uniform stops students expressing who they are.’

Write the text for a speech to be given to a school assembly in which you explain your views on this statement.

Your speech may include:
• arguments for and against school uniform
• possible compromises
• any other points you wish to make.

**OR**

**(b)** ‘Parents today are too strict with their teenage children.’

Write an article for a national newspaper in which you give your views on this statement.

Your article may include:
• why parents set rules
• how much freedom teenagers should have
• any other points you wish to make.

Your answer will be assessed on how accurately and appropriately you use vocabulary, spelling, punctuation and grammar.

• any other points you wish to make.

parts.text:
Answer ONE of the following tasks, (a) or (b).

**EITHER**

**(a)** ‘Travelling to other countries is the best education a young person can have.’

Write the text for a speech to be given to members of your community at a public meeting in which you explain your views on this statement.

Your speech may include:
• what people can learn from travel
• whether travel is possible or desirable for everyone
• any other points you wish to make.

**OR**

**(b)** Your headteacher is considering requiring every student to complete twenty hours of volunteering each year.

Write a letter to your headteacher in which you give your views on this idea.

Your letter may include:
• how this idea would affect students and the school
• what you think should happen instead, or how the idea could be improved
• any other points you wish to make.

Your answer will be assessed on how accurately and appropriately you use vocabulary, spelling, punctuation and grammar.

• how to look after yourself during exam season
• any other points you wish to make.

Your answer will be assessed on how accurately and appropriately you use vocabulary, spelling, punctuation and grammar.

• any other points you wish to make.

• what money can and cannot provide
• the things that make people truly content
• any other points you wish to make.
